title: My First Platformer
goal: Combine sprite, hitbox, gravity, score, and 1 level.
mascot_lines: A platformer is a game with a hero who jumps from platform to platform.
There are coins to grab, bad guys to dodge, and a flag to reach at the end.
Lots of famous games are platformers — and now you're about to make your own!
Press the arrow keys to move, then press space or up to jump.

tier2.rephrase: Order the steps to make a platformer game.

tier3.nudge: Hero first. Then world. Then physics. Then score. Then test!

payload.prompt: Bring it all together. Avoid bad guys, grab coins, reach the flag!

reflect.prompt: What is the special part of YOUR platformer?

questions.math_tip: Read hundreds, tens, then ones. Each place is worth ten times the place to its right.

variations.prompt: In 785, which digit is in the tens place?

questions.math_tip: Add the ones first. Ten ones can be regrouped as one ten.

variations.prompt: What is 57 plus 25?

questions.math_tip: If there are not enough ones, trade one ten for ten ones.
